technique_name: Design a survey to measure customer satisfaction with a new online store.
description:
1. How would you rate your overall experience with our store? 
    a. Very Satisfied
    b. Satisfied
    c. Neutral
    d. Dissatisfied
    e. Very Dissatisfied

2. How easy is it to find the items you need in our store? 
    a. Very Easy
    b. Easy 
    c. Neutral
    d. Difficult 
    e. Very Difficult

3. How satisfied have you been with the quality of your purchases from our store?
    a. Very Satisfied
    b. Satisfied
    c. Neutral
    d. Dissatisfied
    e. Very Dissatisfied
